comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/390539624 (Roundtop Mountain Resort, landuse=winter_sports with leisure=sports_centre): the north face of Roundtop above Lewisberry, from the summit to the base lodge, the Mountain View Lodge and the snow tubing park, on one ticket and one map (Epic); it holds every lift and run. No other ski area lies in the box or the Overpass window. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-12 against Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes): the trail-map page links it as the Roundtop Winter 2024-2025 Trail Map; the site serves curl an error page, so the PDF (two pages, the painting on the first, 911 x 685 pt, an image with no text layer) was fetched with WebFetch and rendered at two to eight times its size, read tile by tile. Its key: Easier (green circle), More Difficult (blue square), Most Difficult (black diamond) and Freestyle Terrain (an orange pill); two trails carry two diamonds, which the key does not list, read as OSM's expert as at the other resorts; its lifts are the Ramrod Triple, Exhibition Quad, Minuteman Quad, Fife & Drum Triple and Drummer Boy Quad chairs, the J-Bar, the Magic Mtn. Lift, Revere's Ride (a surface lift) and the Snow Tubing Lift, the nine lifts the resort's mountain-info page counts. The resort's lift and trail status loads by script, so the printed map is the source and wins. OSM draws most runs twice, as a line and as an outline (area=yes, as at Camelback); overrides name each way. Ratings from the map: Upper Ramrod (two diamonds; advanced in OSM), Upper Exhibition (one diamond; expert in OSM, with the 50 m piece OSM names Exhibition at the Exhibition Quad's top) and Recruit (one diamond on a black line; intermediate in OSM). Names from the map: Upper Lafayette's Leap and Lower Lafayette's Leap (OSM Upper and Lower Lafeyette Leap; the map's lower label reads LAFAYETT'S, its upper one LAFAYETTE'S, whose spelling is kept for both, and OSM's second Upper outline is the lower trail's), Barrett's Trail (Barrett's trail), Fife & Drum (Fife and Drum), Upper Exhibition for OSM's Exhibition piece and J-Bar for OSM's unnamed J-bar. Hidden: the 101 m line OSM names Half Pipe, inside J-Bar Park's outline beside the J-Bar, as the map draws no halfpipe (J-Bar Park is OSM's outline, a snow park, labelled from z14). Parks: the map's three freestyle pills sit on Recruit, Fife & Drum and J-Bar Park, the resort's three terrain parks; their outlines are snow parks in OSM, and the Recruit and Fife & Drum lines, ordinary trails on the map, get no park flag (a flag would draw the whole trail as a park, as at Hunter Mountain's Lower 42nd Street). Palisade Glade (one diamond) is OSM's 92 m glade line, tagged backcountry and inside the polygon, so it stays in bounds; the glade's wooded outline, a closed way named Palisade without area=yes that the pipeline would draw as a loop of run line, is hidden, as Winter Park's Wildwood Glade loops are. Kept as OSM has them: the lifts Magic Mountain (MAGIC MTN. LIFT) and Fife & Drum (the painting's FIFE & DRUM TRIPLE CHAIR), and Discovery Area's two outlines (novice in OSM, drawn green). The zip line and the tubing lanes are left out by their types. OSM gaps: none of the map's 20 trail names (the resort counts 21 trails) or nine lifts is missing.

overrides.reason: Upper Ramrod (OSM's line), from the Ramrod Triple's top down beside the chair, carries two black diamonds on Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes); OSM rates it advanced. The printed map wins.

Upper Ramrod (OSM's outline), from the Ramrod Triple's top down beside the chair, carries two black diamonds on Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes); OSM rates it advanced. The printed map wins.

Upper Exhibition (OSM's line), from the Exhibition Quad's top down between Upper Ramrod and the chair, carries one black diamond on Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes), which marks Upper Gunbarrel and Upper Ramrod beside it with two; OSM rates it expert. The printed map wins.

Upper Exhibition (OSM's outline), from the Exhibition Quad's top down between Upper Ramrod and the chair, carries one black diamond on Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes), which marks Upper Gunbarrel and Upper Ramrod beside it with two; OSM rates it expert. The printed map wins.

Exhibition: the 50 m piece from the Exhibition Quad's top onto Upper Exhibition, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) draws as the top of UPPER EXHIBITION, one black diamond; OSM rates it expert. Name and rating from the map.

Upper Lafeyette Leap (OSM's line): the black trail from the summit lodge down beside Bunker Hill, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) labels UPPER LAFAYETTE'S LEAP with one black diamond. Spelling from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Upper Lafeyette Leap (OSM's outline): the black trail from the summit lodge down beside Bunker Hill, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) labels UPPER LAFAYETTE'S LEAP with one black diamond. Spelling from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Upper Lafeyette Leap, the second outline of that name: it lies round OSM's Lower Lafeyette Leap line, the blue trail from Bunker Hill's foot past Palisade Glade to the base, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) labels LOWER LAFAYETT'S LEAP with a blue square (its upper label spells LAFAYETTE'S, kept for both). Name from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Lower Lafeyette Leap: the blue trail from Bunker Hill's foot past Palisade Glade to the base, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) labels LOWER LAFAYETT'S LEAP with a blue square (its upper label spells LAFAYETTE'S, kept for both). Name from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Barrett's trail (OSM's line): the black trail from the summit along the ski area boundary to Powderhorn and Fanny Hill, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) labels BARRETT'S TRAIL with one black diamond. Capitalisation from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Barrett's trail (OSM's outline): the black trail from the summit along the ski area boundary to Powderhorn and Fanny Hill, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) labels BARRETT'S TRAIL with one black diamond. Capitalisation from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Recruit: the trail between Susquehanna and Minuteman, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) draws as a black line with one black diamond (and a freestyle pill near its top); OSM rates it intermediate. The printed map wins; the line gets no park flag (an ordinary trail on the map; its park is OSM's Recruit outline).

Recruit's outline, a snow park in OSM: Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) marks Recruit with one black diamond and a freestyle pill, one of the resort's three terrain parks; OSM rates it intermediate. The printed map wins.

Fife and Drum (OSM's line): the blue trail beside the Fife & Drum Triple, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) labels FIFE & DRUM with a blue square and a freestyle pill. Name from the map, as OSM names the chair; OSM's rating is the map's, and the line gets no park flag (its park is OSM's outline).

Fife and Drum (OSM's outline, a snow park): the trail beside the Fife & Drum Triple, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) labels FIFE & DRUM with a blue square and a freestyle pill. Name from the map, as OSM names the chair; OSM's rating is the map's.

Half Pipe: a 101 m straight line inside OSM's J-Bar Park outline, beside the J-Bar. Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) draws no halfpipe; the lane there is J-BAR PARK, with a blue square and a freestyle pill, one of the resort's three terrain parks, which OSM's J-Bar Park outline (a snow park) draws and names. Hidden as a feature the resort no longer shows (renamed instead, it would be a second J-Bar Park and, as the only named park line, rank as a trunk run).

Palisade: the wooded outline of Palisade Glade (a closed way tagged natural=wood, gladed=yes and piste:type=downhill without area=yes), which the pipeline would draw as a 329 m loop of black run line round OSM's 92 m Palisade Glade line. Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) shows PALISADE GLADE, one black diamond, as a short glade between Bunker Hill and Lower Lafayette's Leap, drawn here by that line. Hidden until OpenStreetMap tags it area=yes, as Winter Park's Wildwood Glade loops; this expect then stops the build.

An unnamed J-bar (114 m) at the foot of J-Bar Park, which Roundtop's Winter 2024-2025 trail map (20241205_RO_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the 60th-anniversary painting skiroundtop.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links, the newest the resort publishes) draws and labels J-BAR. Name from the map.
